question: Should dashboard execution proceed while the Crown branch is behind current main by four commits?
desiredState: Use current canonical dashboard owners and guardrails for all Observatory work.
executableConstraint: Main advanced to ece51db after PR #95, adding dashboard baseline guardrails, lazy widget extraction and a computed-style snapshot harness. The Crown branch still has merge-base 4a103111.
recommendedResolution: Do not execute dashboard runtime changes from the stale base. Refresh the branch from current main first, then re-resolve owners and tests before any Observatory implementation.
